definitions.explanation: Traveling from place to place without a fixed destination or home. Can be romantic (the wandering artist) or negative (homelessness), depending on context.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放浪|ほうろう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I wandered the world.

examples.japanese: {放浪|ほうろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧がいた。
examples.english: There was a poet who set out on a wandering journey.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めて⟦{一年間|いちねんかん}→一年間：28882_ichinenkan⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放浪|ほうろう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{人生観|じんせいかん}→人生観：21063_jinseikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The experience of quitting my job and wandering Europe for a year changed my outlook on life.

notes:
USAGE:
Carries a literary, romantic quality when describing travel with no fixed plans. In negative contexts, can imply vagrancy or aimlessness. Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify nouns: {放浪|ほうろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧ (wandering journey), {放浪|ほうろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧ (wandering painter).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {放浪|ほうろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: a wandering journey
- ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放浪|ほうろう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wander from place to place
- {放浪|ほうろう}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a nomadic life
- {放浪|ほうろう}{者|しゃ}: a wanderer, vagrant
